name: Algebra 1 Recurring + Assessment Resource Profile
extends: current Base Recurring + Assessment Resources PM
role: Course-specific renderer/routing layer. It does not replace the Assessment Plan or canonical Bank content.

source_ownership.warmups: Finalized Unit Bank canonical Warm-Up routes; counts/routing owned by profiles/bank_course_profile.json.
source_ownership.exit_tickets: Finalized Unit Bank canonical Exit Ticket A/B/C routes; counts/routing owned by profiles/bank_course_profile.json.
source_ownership.progress_tracker: Original requested Unit Assessment Plan + profiles/assessment_evidence_philosophy.json. Bank is not the learning-goal authority.
source_ownership.review: Original Unit Assessment Plan current Unit Mastery Goals + exact supporting I-cans; finalized Bank may supply non-secure Mastery-aligned questions/figures, but the Retrieval stage does not define the Unit Review artifact.
source_ownership.summative: Finalized Unit Bank secure Summative routes + profiles/bank_course_profile.json Summative behavior.

warmups.layout: Current Algebra Bank inventory resolves to four questions per warm-up. Render two physical/import pages with questions 1–2 on the header page and 3–4 on the continuation page.

notability_geometry.rule: Do not force a full-page container height; preserve tested Notability import behavior.

warmups.figures: Copy canonical Bank figure bytes; no graph tool in the Warm-Up output.
warmups.workspace_rule: No visible workspace element. The blank remainder of each fixed-height problem card is the Notability writing area. Prefer no workspace div; if legacy markup is retained, only workspace wu-ws-000 is allowed.
workspace_prohibitions: No nonzero wu-ws-* utility in the normal Algebra Warm-Up build

exit_tickets.menu: First viewport is a full-screen index organized by section with Ticket A/B/C links.
exit_tickets.ticket_layout: Current Algebra Bank inventory resolves to four questions per ticket. Each ticket is one full viewport with a 2x2 grid and no student workspace.
exit_tickets.versions: A/B/C per section come from Bank destinations; do not author a fourth version in the renderer.
exit_tickets.figures_tables: Keep compact enough for all four questions to fit; prompt before representation.

progress_tracker.organization: Mastery Goal -> supporting exact I-can statements -> portfolio evidence -> current evidence status -> next move.
prohibitions: Do not revive Getting There / Got It! / Teach It! labels

review.target_rule: The deployed Unit Review is a mastery-preparation resource for the CURRENT Unit. Route it from the current Unit Mastery Goals and exact supporting I-cans. Never route the Unit Review from the Retrieval stage merely because the resource is called Review. Historical source-unit identity remains internal to the Assessment Plan/source map and is not student-facing.
navigation: Practice Problems link in the top navigation
review.practice_question_rule: Use four open-response questions per current Unit Mastery Goal. Prefer non-secure Bank questions already aligned to that same Mastery Goal/supporting I-can. If too few appropriate non-secure questions exist, author fresh parallel review questions directly from the Mastery Goal/supporting I-cans. Do not copy secure Summative items or official Exit Tickets.
review.visible_intro_pattern: Review the skills and understandings from your Unit {U} Mastery Goals.
review.organization: One review focus per current Unit Mastery Goal, with its exact supporting I-cans, concise synthesis, useful representations, common traps, DOK perspective when meaningful, and final check.
review.student_facing_source_identity: Do not print prior/source Unit numbers or titles. The Review, Review Practice, Progress Tracker, and Summative belong to the current Unit and use current Unit Mastery Goal IDs.
review.content_owner: Current Algebra Framework + ORIGINAL current Unit Assessment Plan
review.shell_owner: Current Base Recurring + Assessment PM canonical Review renderer
review.shell_override_rule: Do not reconstruct or restyle the Review from this profile; use the Base Recurring canonical shell exactly.

summative.layout: One-column constructed-response exam pages. Use compact/standard/large/xlarge problem-card sizing by real workspace demand; blank area inside each card is student workspace.
summative.student_metadata: Hide DOK/section/Bank/internal labels; hidden traceability may remain.
summative.form_behavior: Resolve active form IDs from profiles/bank_course_profile.json#summative and the finalized secure Bank. The current Algebra profile resolves to V1-V6: V1-V4 same-day parallel and V5-V6 makeup/alternate. Do not invent extra forms, and treat any V7/V8 found only in an older rendered/template artifact as stale layout residue.
summative.time: Use Bank profile time target (currently max about 45 minutes).
summative.figures_tables: Prompt first; compact centered tables; canonical figures directly below prompt.
summative.stale_template_guard: Rendered/reference HTML is visual evidence only. It cannot override current Bank/Framework form membership. Version labels/selectors/keys must be generated from the resolved active form IDs.

packaging.shared_css: Do not duplicate shared root CSS inside ordinary Unit resource ZIPs.
